data.content:
Zanetti could initially use a 3-4-2-1, with Nicolò Zaniolo and Jurgen Ekkelenkamp supporting Keinan Davis, although his plans remain uncertain.

Davis has delivered two league assists without scoring, but Venezia's porous back line could provide the opening he needs to end that drought.

Four of Udinese's five league points have come away from home, suggesting the visitors may be better equipped to compete on their travels. [...] With just six goals all season, Venezia have the division's weakest scoring record and could struggle to take advantage of Udinese's defensive problems.

Nicola is expected to retain his 3-5-2 formation, with Akor Adams and John Yeboah the leading candidates to start up front.
